name: 💵FARM💵Planetary Tower Defense
desc:
Join the Planetary Tower Defense group for an extra 100 starting cash! 💵

Play as a Commander of the Special Divisions, tasked with defending Earth from incoming alien threats sent by an opposing enemy faction.
Gameplay is strategic, unforgiving, and brutal. Every small decision will determine life or death.


⚠️ IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO READ THE TUTORIAL IN THE "Help" SECTION BEFORE PLAYING"⚠️
